mat.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production texture derivation from the approved L5R crimson duel concept. Preserve the original design faithfully: dark charcoal-indigo densely woven cloth, fine worn interlaced fabric pattern, oxblood binding, thin aged gold geometric corner trim, subtle dark dried blood stains at lower-left and lower-right margins. The crossed-katana emblem with the FIVE elemental ring glyphs below it remains in muted off-white/gray, embedded in the weave, horizontally centered and located in the upper-middle of the cloth (group centered at x50%, y30%, from y9% through y49%). No text, no cards, no buttons, no shadows of removed objects, no landscape, no fake playing zones, no weapons as physical objects. Absolutely top-down with parallel sides and no perspective or lighting gradient. This is a game albedo texture for a real 3D cloth surface, not another scene mockup.
